rule: Each agent may use only its own character. Keep identity, silhouette, palette, proportions, and signature accessories consistent. These are original generic characters, not provider logos or mascots.

claude_comet.name: Comet
claude_comet.visual_identity: A small warm-orange fox-like explorer with a cream muzzle, one teal scarf, and a tiny star-shaped satchel badge.
claude_comet.silhouette: Pointed ears, compact rounded body, fluffy tail with a cream tip.
claude_comet.signature_motion: Quick curious head tilts and short tail swishes.

opencode_spark.name: Spark
opencode_spark.visual_identity: A compact mint-green helper robot with a rounded square head, one dark face screen, two small antenna dots, and a yellow lightning-shaped chest mark.
opencode_spark.silhouette: Rounded square head, small capsule body, short articulated arms.
opencode_spark.signature_motion: Small mechanical hops and a two-frame chest-light pulse.

codex_owl.name: Pixel
codex_owl.visual_identity: A cobalt-blue little owl with oversized circular amber glasses, a pale belly, and a tiny notebook tucked under one wing.
codex_owl.silhouette: Wide owl head, short wings, small feet, round glasses.
codex_owl.signature_motion: One-wing page flip and a deliberate double blink.

chatgpt_orbit.name: Orbit
chatgpt_orbit.visual_identity: A violet floating star-compass character with a soft rounded four-point silhouette, two expressive eyes, and a small orbiting golden dot.
chatgpt_orbit.silhouette: Rounded four-point star with a single orbiting dot.
chatgpt_orbit.signature_motion: Gentle rotation and a short orbiting-dot loop.
